book_title: Bedtime Very Short Stories For Kids: Collection of 22 Magical Arabian Nights Tales
author: Alexandre Ellis
book_description: What did Ali Baba hear the thieves yell to the hill?How many sea adventures brave Sinbad, the Sailor did?Who lives in the mysterious City of Brass?Inside this new book series you wish you had growing up, put your loved ones to bed reading very short magical tales from the One Thousand and One Nights! Full of mysteries, intrigue and magical landscapes.Short and interesting stories to finish the day on a positive way.Very short yet meaningful stories not to overwhelm the kids.Teaches behaviours to overcome everyday problems and situations.Great topics to start deep conversations.Make sure the time to go to bed is magical, scroll up and click on "BUY NOW" to start reading very quickly!Show more
